title: Finding the Potential Function of a Planar Conservative Field
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Verify that F = <2xy + cos(x), x^2 + 3y^2> is conservative and find its scalar potential function f(x, y).
finalAnswer: f(x, y) = x^2 y + \sin(x) + y^3 + C

steps.title: Verify Component Equality
steps.mathExpression: \frac{\partial M}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(2xy + \cos x) = 2x; \quad \frac{\partial N}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial}{\partial x}(x^2 + 3y^2) = 2x
steps.explanation: Since M_y = N_x on all of R^2 (simply connected), F is conservative.

steps.title: Integrate M with Respect to x
steps.mathExpression: f(x, y) = \int (2xy + \cos x) \, dx = x^2 y + \sin x + g(y)
steps.explanation: The constant of integration g(y) is a function of y alone.

steps.title: Differentiate with Respect to y and Match N
steps.mathExpression: \frac{\partial f}{\partial y} = x^2 + g'(y) = x^2 + 3y^2 \implies g'(y) = 3y^2 \implies g(y) = y^3 + C
steps.explanation: Equate partial derivative to N(x, y).
